The landing gear

retracting mechanism and supporting structure shall be designed for the maximum load factors in the flight conditions when the gear is in the retracted position. It shall also be designed for the combination of friction, inertia, brake torque, and air loads occurring during retraction at any air speed up to 1.6 Vs,, flaps retracted and any load factors up to those specified for the flaps extended condition, § 3.190. The landing gear and retracting mechanism, including the wheel well doors, shall withstand flight loads with the landing gear extended at any speed up to at least 1.6 Vs, flaps retracted. Positive means shall be provided for the purpose of maintaining the wheels in the extended position.
